authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 4.7: 0x11 marks the end of the R2004 compressed stream
change: Append 0x11 to the page map and section map compressed payloads, include it in both declared compressed sizes and checksums, and include it in the page map's self-referential page size.

automated_validation.checks: Generated physical page maps and section maps for four versions: declared bounds, exact terminal opcode, independently calculated checksum, complete decode, pre-existing no-terminator stream tolerance, clipped physical-page rejection and self-page size.

external_differential.producer: locally generated single LINE AC1018; no sample is committed
external_differential.reader: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, ACAD2013 DXF output; examine .err and actual output because process status is zero even for failed conversions
external_differential.terminator_only_result: Object improperly read: <AcDbDictionary> (C); previous error: .dwg file needs recovery; no DXF produced
external_differential.both_result: Object improperly read: <AcDbDictionary> (C); previous error: .dwg file needs recovery; no DXF produced
external_differential.independent_trace: LibreDWG 0.14 baseline reports bit_read_RC buffer overflow at physical EOF while reading the page map; the terminator-only file no longer reports this overflow. Both traces still show the LINE.
external_differential.qualification_limit: This isolates one malformed system-stream defect and moves ODA past its earlier rejection. It does not establish successful independent reading or general DWG support; dictionary/graph diagnosis remains open.

separate_followup: A raw decompressor experiment using a literal-only page with its last literal omitted reported success; it is a separate reader-safety issue and was not used as a requirement for this writer fix.
